summary: Frontend regression + feature verification for RES site. Verified (1) Team page bug fix — all 6 team cards render with computed opacity=1 and initials avatars (no inside team-page), designations & credential badges shown; (2) Home page stagger regressions — Featured Projects (6), Team (6), Services all visible; 0 blocks with opacity=0 across full page scroll; (3) Certification band — 5 tiles (LEED/IGBC/GRIHA/EDGE/WELL) all loaded (naturalWidth=1024, complete=true) inside [data-testid='certification-band']; (4) Launch blog article visible on /blog with blog-card- testid, click opens /blog/why-green-building-certification-is-a-strategic-advantage rendering title, 4 subheadings and 7 paragraphs at opacity 1. Backend spot-checked: /api/public/team returns 6 active members with empty profile_image, /api/public/home returns credential_logos length 5 and team length 6, /api/public/blogs returns 1 published item with the expected slug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_1 covered full admin CRUD (28/28 backend, 11/11 frontend) — do not re-run unless changes. Iteration_2 confirmed the StaggerItem whileInView per-item fix in Reveal.jsx (Team page cards now render at opacity 1). Certification band uses external emergent static image URLs which are reachable and load properly. Blog detail route: /blog/<slug>. data-testids in use: team-page, certification-band, blog-page, blog-detail-page, blog-card-<slug>.
rca of the issue: Previously fixed: Framer Motion Stagger container fired whileInView before async /api/public/team resolved, leaving children stuck at opacity 0. Fix moved whileInView to per-item (StaggerItem), so each newly-mounted card triggers its own reveal after data load. Verified: computed opacity=1 for all 6 name-anchored cards on /team.
